project.name: Eco-Loop Building Agents
project.primaryGoal: Reduce EnergyPlus HVAC electricity while maintaining occupied-zone Fanger PMV comfort through an autonomous LangGraph and MCP control loop.

features.name: Engineering documentation baseline
features.description: Create the technical specification, modular feature list, implementation plan, progress tracker, current status, and agent guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: All requested documentation files exist.
Feature IDs and statuses agree across featurelist.json and progress.md.
A new agent can identify the current stage and next action from current-status.md.

features.name: Autonomous feature-delivery orchestration
features.description: Define and activate the controlled Developer, Tester, and Senior Technical Lead loop with automatic documentation synchronization and safety-based approval gates.
acceptanceCriteria: The workflow documents feature states, role ownership, verification, rework, retries, and completion.
Safe autonomous actions and mandatory user-approval actions are explicitly separated.
A bounded Codex heartbeat resumes work from current-status.md and stops at the submission deadline.
All agent guidance requires automatic documentation synchronization.

features.name: Python repository scaffold
features.description: Initialize Git, pyproject.toml, source/test layout, dependency groups, environment template, Ruff, Pyright, Pytest, and ignore rules.
acceptanceCriteria: The project installs into an isolated virtual environment.
Lint, type-check, and test commands execute successfully.
Generated runs, model weights, and secrets are excluded from Git.

features.name: EnergyPlus and Ollama feasibility
features.description: Install or locate EnergyPlus, Ollama, Qwen3 4B, example models, and New Delhi weather; record exact versions and validate basic execution.
acceptanceCriteria: EnergyPlus runs an official example successfully.
Ollama returns a valid structured response from Qwen3 4B or the documented smaller fallback.
Version and path diagnostics are available through the project CLI.

features.name: Model and weather preparation
features.description: Prepare the small-office New Delhi experiment, People/Fanger settings, output variables, meter, writable cooling schedule, and fixed run period.
acceptanceCriteria: Baseline and controlled IDFs are versioned separately.
The model reports zone temperature, PMV, PPD, occupancy, outdoor temperature, and HVAC electricity.
The actuator dictionary proves the selected schedule actuator is writable.

features.name: Baseline simulation pipeline
features.description: Run the fixed-schedule baseline and normalize EnergyPlus outputs into observations.csv and summary.json.
acceptanceCriteria: A seven-day baseline completes.
HVAC kWh and occupied PMV metrics are reproducible.
Run metadata records model, weather, dates, timestep, and software version.

features.name: Active control session
features.description: Implement EnergyPlus callbacks, sensor/meter handles, the decision-boundary bridge, actuator writes, and safe session shutdown.
acceptanceCriteria: A one-day smoke run publishes observations at control boundaries.
A test action visibly changes the active cooling setpoint.
Missing handles and fatal EnergyPlus errors stop safely with diagnostics.

features.name: FastMCP EnergyPlus server
features.description: Expose typed simulation lifecycle, observation, trend, constraints, action, status, error, reset, and summary tools.
acceptanceCriteria: All tools return typed JSON-compatible content with units.
Stale and duplicate actions are rejected deterministically.
Tool errors are normalized and logged.

features.name: Local structured LLM provider
features.description: Implement the Ollama provider, Qwen3 configuration, Pydantic structured output, timeouts, latency logging, and smaller-model fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Energy, comfort, and supervisor schemas parse reliably.
Malformed responses trigger bounded correction.
Model unavailability produces a controlled fallback signal.

features.name: Safety validator and fallback policy
features.description: Enforce PMV bands, setpoint bounds, rate limits, freshness, retry limits, and deterministic occupied/unoccupied fallback actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Unsafe or stale actions cannot reach the actuator.
All boundary and fallback paths have unit tests.
Every rejection returns a machine-readable reason.

features.name: LangGraph typed state machine
features.description: Implement named workflow states, conditional routing, bounded retries, fallback, completion, failure, checkpointing, and streamed events.
acceptanceCriteria: The complete perception-to-reflection process is represented as graph nodes and edges.
Approved, rejected, fallback, finish, and fatal paths are testable without EnergyPlus.
Graph node events can be consumed by the dashboard.

features.name: Energy, Comfort, and Supervisor agents
features.description: Implement role prompts and typed outputs for energy proposal, PMV assessment, conflict resolution, explanation, and reflection.
acceptanceCriteria: Each role has a distinct input/output contract.
The supervisor references both energy and comfort evidence.
Reflection compares predicted and measured outcomes.

features.name: Audit log and quantitative evaluation
features.description: Persist observation, action, graph-event, error, and summary records; calculate energy, cost, PMV, autonomy, and reliability metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Every decision is traceable by run and decision ID.
Baseline and controlled summaries use the same calculation code.
Comparison output includes kWh savings and occupied PMV compliance.

features.name: Closed-loop controlled experiment
features.description: Execute and tune the seven-day agent-controlled New Delhi simulation, then produce the accepted baseline comparison.
acceptanceCriteria: The controlled run completes without an unhandled exception.
No unsafe action is applied.
HVAC energy is lower than baseline and occupied PMV compliance is at least 90%.

features.name: Streamlit results dashboard
features.description: Visualize current graph state, PMV, temperature, setpoint, cumulative energy, decisions, savings, compliance, rejections, and fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: The dashboard loads a live or completed run locally.
All judging metrics are visible and correctly labeled.
The dashboard remains read-only and cannot corrupt a run.

features.name: Automated and manual verification
features.description: Complete unit, graph, MCP contract, EnergyPlus smoke, integration, repeatability, and dashboard tests.
acceptanceCriteria: All automated checks pass from a clean environment.
The final controlled run meets required acceptance criteria.
A manual demo rehearsal completes without intervention.

features.name: Hackathon submission package
features.description: Finalize README and architecture report, public GitHub repository, curated run artifacts, presentation, three-minute video, and upload package.
acceptanceCriteria: The public repository URL is accessible.
All problem-statement deliverables are included.
The presentation and video accurately demonstrate the active closed loop and measured results.
